_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the information architecture of The Playpen School site. build.py and shell.py read this file; nothing about which pages exist, how they are grouped, what the menu and footer show, or which phone numbers appear is written anywhere else. Page ids (P02...) are the ids in DS's full site plan (P03 'Welcome from the Principal' is not built: it needs the Principal's own words). 'slug' is always the URL path with a leading and a trailing slash. A page's source lives at build/pages/<slug-without-slashes>.html or build/pages/<slug>/index.html. Fields per page: id, slug, label (short name for menu, footer, breadcrumb), title (document title and default H1), template (T01..T12, see 'templates'), parent (breadcrumb parent slug or null), group (key of the primary-menu group or null), menu (true = listed under its group in the full-screen menu), footer (footer column key or null), description (SEO meta description, 60 to 170 characters, plain text with no HTML entities, factual), summary (one line for chapter cards and the human sitemap), optional: eyebrow, og_image (path under site/assets/), noindex, schema (school | faq | contact | about | collection | article), sitemap (false keeps it out of sitemap.xml and the search index), actions (false hides the sticky actions on that page).
